title: Graph Laplacian assisted regularization method under noise level free heuristic and statistical stopping rule
summary: In this work, we address the solution of both linear and nonlinear ill-posed inverse problems by developing a novel graph-based regularization framework, where the regularization term is formulated through an iteratively updated graph Laplacian. The proposed approach operates without prior knowledge of the noise level and employs two distinct stopping criteria namely, the heuristic rule and the statistical discrepancy principle.
